events.title: The Snowy Trail Ahead - Devlog!
events.summary: Hiya Friends! This is our first ever devlog 😮. We've been a little quiet the past couple of months, just keeping our head down and working hard, so we thought you all deserved an update. Recently we have been working on The Docks, the 3rd area of our game. This includes making new characters, new buildings, and keeping our quests in mind. events.title: Demo Out Now! ☃️❄️
events.summary: Hey everyone! Our demo is now avaliable! 🎉 Come help out the community of Winterlight Harbor by clearing the snow away from the first area of our game: The Neighborhood. Enjoy the first 15 minutes of our cozy snow cleaning game - build some snowmen, set up some firepits, and help make the Neighborhood safe for your neighbors. events.summary: Hiya Friends! events.title: 10,000 Wishlists!?
events.summary: Hiya Friends! Honestly can't believe we can say this - Winter Whiskers just reached ⭐ 10,000 wishlists ⭐ today! We are truely blown away by the reception our little snow cleaning game has gotten so far. The 10k milestone is one that a lot of game devs talk about, it can help a lot with visibility as a game continues to grow, reach launch time, and even post launch.
